newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan price movements in line with recovery - BOJ.
newsitem.headline: Japan price movements in line with recovery - BOJ.

text.p: Price movements in Japan are in line with a gradual recovery in the economy, a Bank of Japan (BOJ) official told reporters on Thursday.

The official said a smaller year-on-year drop in the domestic wholesale price index December than a month earlier "was in line with the BOJ's view that the economy is gradually recovering. This trend is likely to continue."

In year-on-year terms, the domestic wholesale price index slipped 0.5 percent in December after falling 0.6 percent in November. It was the fourth month in a row in which the scale of the decline had shrunk.
